gripOrHq.title: Project Babylon
gripOrHq.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

gripOrHq.title: Project Venice
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Cortical Scrub
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

gripOrHq.title: Systematic Layoffs
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Setup!
heapOrArchives.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

heapOrArchives.title: Management Shake-Up
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Systematic Layoffs
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Retreat
scoreArea.rulesText: You lose the following ability as soon as you rez or install any card. A: Gain [2].

discardCards.title: Omnitech Wet Drive
discardCards.rulesText: Your base MU is equal to the number of cards in your hand instead of 4.

discardCards.title: Rent-I-Con
discardCards.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

discardCards.title: Meat Upgrade
discardCards.rulesText: Remove up to two tags, at no cost, and draw three cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Running Interference
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. During that run, the Corp must pay [X], in addition to the normal cost, to rez each piece of ice, where X is the rez cost of that piece of ice. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Schematics Search Engine
discardCards.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, expose all of the Corp's installed cards.

discardCards.title: Library Search
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on R&D or HQ. If run is successful, access two additional cards if you used no noisy icebreakers during the run and if no trace attempts were made during the run.

discardCards.title: Rent-I-Con
discardCards.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

discardCards.title: Meat Upgrade
discardCards.rulesText: Remove up to two tags, at no cost, and draw three cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: MS-todon
discardCards.rulesText: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. The first time during each run that you break a sentry subroutine with MS-todon, lose all bits from all stealth cards, if you can, and the Corp gives you a tag.

rig.title: Crash Space
rig.rulesText: Gain [1] at the start of each of your turns. All trace attempts are automatically successful, and give you a tag in addition to their other effects. If Crash Space leaves play, lose [2]. A: Trash Crash Space. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

ice.title: Caryatid
ice.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Caryatid, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a code gate instead of a wall.

root.title: Security Purge
root.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.
